=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_escalation_judge_command.py:163-167 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test does not assert that `<stage> — budget ES-<n>` or `<stage> — descope ES-<n>` appears in the Stage templates.
  WHY: If a future change removes these values, no test will fail, allowing the templates to drift from the escalation judge's documented behavior.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Ensure the contract tests pin the `<stage> — budget ES-<n>` and `<stage> — descope ES-<n>` Stage values in the Progress Log and Output Format templates.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_escalation_judge_command.py::test_log_template_has_escalations_section
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The test at line 163 extracts the log template from `**Log file format:**` to `### Lessons` and asserts three things: the Escalations section header format, section ordering, and the CLOSED status value. It does not assert `<stage> — budget ES-<n>` in the template. The Stage template at `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:344` (and its twin at `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:344`) contains `<stage> — budget ES-<n>`, and the Output Format template at line 402 matches. Both are present in the template range the test reads, but neither is pinned. The existing test asserts the ## Escalations header, ordering, and CLOSED (not planned, ES-<n>) Status value, but does not assert the presence of <stage> — budget ES-<n> or <stage> — descope ES-<n> in the Stage template; test_log_template_has_escalations_section in tests/test_escalation_judge_command.py does not pin these values. The current body only checks the `## Escalations` section header format, its ordering before `## Auto-decisions`, and the `CLOSED (not planned, ES-<n>)` Status value. It extracts `template = plan[plan.index("**Log file format:**"):plan.index("### Lessons")]`, which already contains the Progress Log Stage line, but no assertion references `<stage> — budget ES-<n>` or `descope ES-<n>`. The Output Format Stage template (after `### Lessons`) is also not in `template` and not asserted. The cross-pollination consensus flagged this exact gap (gemini + glm, confidence 4), and the PR's own log records that round 1 added `<stage> — budget ES-<n>` to both Stage templates without extending the test that anchors them. The PR description and the plan checklist claim the contract tests pin the escalation judge's Stage template values, including `<stage> — budget ES-<n>` (added in review round 1 to both Stage templates in `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md`). The test `test_log_template_has_escalations_section` is the test that covers the log template's Stage line but does not assert this value. The value is correctly present in both Stage templates (Progress Log template at line ~343 and Output Format template at line ~401 of the twin), so runtime behavior is correct; the gap is that a future regression removing the budget Stage value would not be caught.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
